title: Kuchisake-onna: the woman in the mask

scenes.title: KUCHISAKE-ONNA
scenes.text: On a dark street, a woman in a white surgical mask stops you, and asks one question.
scenes.image_prompt: a dark rainy Tokyo suburb street at night, flickering streetlamps, fog, empty road, ominous mood

scenes.text: Nineteen seventy-nine. Children all over Japan told the same story.
scenes.image_prompt: a tall silhouette of a woman with long black hair and a white surgical mask standing far down a foggy night street under a lamp, red glowing eyes

scenes.text: Schools changed their rules, and police increased their patrols.
scenes.image_prompt: a Japanese elementary school at dusk, empty gate, long shadows, a few children hurrying home together, tense mood

scenes.text: The story says she has long black hair, and a pale white mask.
scenes.image_prompt: close-up of a woman with long black hair and a white surgical mask, glowing red eyes, dark teal background, horror comic style

scenes.title: AM I PRETTY?
scenes.text: She steps out of the dark, and asks softly: Am I pretty?
scenes.image_prompt: a woman in a surgical mask stepping out of the fog toward the viewer under a streetlamp, red eyes, horror comic style

scenes.text: If you say yes, she pulls down the mask, and asks again: Even like this?
scenes.image_prompt: dark close-up of a woman's hand slowly pulling down a white surgical mask, face hidden in shadow, red glowing eyes

scenes.label: THE TRICK
scenes.text: Some say the trick is to answer with a question of your own, to confuse her.
scenes.image_prompt: a lone child standing in the middle of a foggy night street holding a small umbrella, facing the dark

scenes.text: Where did she come from? Some folklorists trace her back to Japan's Edo period.
scenes.image_prompt: an old Edo period Japanese village road at dusk, wooden houses, paper lanterns, fog, a single figure in the distance

scenes.text: But the modern story began in nineteen seventy-eight, and exploded across Japan the next year.
scenes.image_prompt: a 1979 Japanese neighborhood at night with phone booths and vending machines glowing, fog, eerie

scenes.title: DON'T ANSWER
scenes.text: So if a stranger in a mask ever asks you a question tonight... don't answer. Run.
scenes.image_prompt: a masked woman on a dark street, very close, red glowing eyes, extreme horror comic style

scenes.title: LEGENDS
scenes.text: Which legend should be next? Comment below, and follow if you dare.
